text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
text.es: Busca las notas de la frase 1: cada una te espera hasta que estés en ella.

text.en: Henry Alford complained in 1865 that his hymn had been "much disfigured by alterations made without the author's consent", and said he was "responsible for this form of it only".

source.en: Henry Alford, The Poetical Works of Henry Alford (London, 1865), p. 300, footnote, read from the scan

text.en: Record the tune of Come, Ye Thankful People, Come in Sing, with the other parts playing.

Alford changed his lines "From His field shall purge away / All that doth offend that day" at the request of the Tract Committee of the Christian Knowledge Society, "as possibly bearing an ambiguous meaning".

source.en: Henry Alford, The Poetical Works of Henry Alford (London, 1865), p. 301, footnote, read from the scan
